rgya gar skad du/ārya tā re stott+ra/bod skad du/'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba las sgro

tei:div.tei:p: )rgya gar skad du/ ārya tā re stott+ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la= ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog 'dra zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// sna tshogs dar gyis legs par brgyan// utpal bsnams la= bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin kun ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su 'khor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo//

slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'o// zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la// rin chen me tog mang po gcal du bkram// me tog puṇḍa ri ka char ltar 'bebs// yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*// nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyod kyis skyob tu gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod// 'phags ma khyod la dad byed pa// de la rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs// bdag kyang khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol// lha mo'i sku mdog zla 'dra'i mdog /sgeg cing dul ba'i cha byad can// gzugs bzang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// mdzes pa dar gyi smad g.yogs can// padma zla ba'i gdan dbus su// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag can// dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum// lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud// khyod la cha tsam bstod pa yis// bdag cag byang chub bsgrub pa la// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog// /
